name: NAUR
author: @sounox (LPDU/NAUR) and Jamie Jams @ Faerie
description: Party mitigation for The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate) from the NAUR sheet by @sounox (LPDU/NAUR) and Jamie Jams @ Faerie, reworked 11/21/2025 for NAUR staff. Pick a tank position, a healer job, or a DPS position.

WHM.name: Divine Benison
WHM.note: On the main tank. 5 seconds before.

AST.name: Celestial Intersection
AST.note: On the main tank. 15 seconds before.

mechanics.note: Press Holos, Kerachole, Sacred Soil, or Temperance once the first doll AoEs go off.

phases.note: Doll feeds and Protean 2 can be tough on healers. Ranged DPS, please use personals on doll feeds, and melee DPS, please use personals on Protean 2 (Second Wind, Manaward, Radiant Aegis, Riddle of Earth, Shade Shift).

P.name: Party Mit
P.note: Press it when Enumeration goes off.

phases.note: Once the first water debuff hits 14 seconds, press Sacred Soil or Kerachole, then on cooldown to cover the rest. This is immediately after Photon.
If a Warrior is in the party, both tanks can swap mits and roles for this phase.
